description.en: An easy first class after the Level 5 benchmark week: two pairs of strict muscle-ups, one set of chest-to-bar pull-ups and straight-bar dips, all with plenty in reserve. The harder pulling returns in the next classes, once the elbows have had their days off.
Measure planche progress through a protracted shoulder line, not through forced hand balance.
Find the longest front-lever shape that keeps shoulders, hips, and feet aligned.

Foot-assisted hang and supported deep-squat hold first, then the weekly skill-mobility block: 34-second wall shoulder openers and bench thoracic extensions for the handstand line, and pancake compression lifts for the L-sit and the press.
Complete partial skin-the-cat reps, advanced-tuck holds, and one-leg holds before the prescribed pull-ups and support work.
Controlled negatives verify the dragon line before any full repetitions are pursued.
A compact circuit closes the week with every basic pattern and enough reserve for the next mastery block.
Four smooth doubles and two controlled negatives improve transition timing without burying the pull and dip basics.

Alternate legs and record only level holds so both front-lever sides develop evenly.

Alternate back-lever legs and keep the shoulder line identical on both sides.

One fresh set of each at the dose this block trained. Rest fully between tests, reach the number shown with clean form and stop at the first form break; the easier option doesn't count today. After the class the app asks which targets you reached.
